preferences.summary: Explain written information verbally using clear, plain language.
preferences.details: Allow extra processing time and check understanding without relying on written materials alone.

accessibilityNeeds.details: Written information requires a verbal explanation and additional processing time.

relationships.name: Sandra Marsden
relationships.notes: Lives with Adam and his younger siblings.

background.summary: Lives with his mother and younger siblings in Ardwick.
Has no wider social network and is experiencing financial difficulties.
Longstanding cannabis, alcohol and tobacco use.
background.details: Cannabis and alcohol use began at age 14; cocaine use is historical. He has been referred to CGL substance misuse services but has not engaged.

background.summary: Has a history of minor offending and remains in monthly contact with probation.
background.details: First arrest was for car theft at age 14. No serious violence or custodial sentence is documented.

background.summary: A paternal uncle had schizophrenia and died by suicide aged 28.
Dyslexia and behavioural difficulties were identified before secondary school.
background.details: His later education included school exclusion following aggressive outbursts.

background.summary: Supported by the Jean McFarlane CMHT under enhanced CPA.
background.details: Care coordinator/CPN Maria Santos visits every three weeks; support worker James Nkosi visits every two weeks; consultant Dr A. Williams reviews approximately every six months. Adam is an informal voluntary patient.

background.summary: Experienced domestic violence, physical abuse and paternal alcohol dependence during childhood.
background.details: His father died when Adam was 15. His later history includes school exclusion and early contact with the criminal justice system.

background.summary: Cannabis-related debts may create vulnerability to exploitation.

problems.details: A recent diagnosis in the source material.
Monitoring is overdue and adherence to metformin has been inconsistent.

entries.summary: Presented to A&E aged 19 with a first psychotic episode.
entries.outcome: Schizophrenia diagnosed after paranoid thoughts, auditory hallucinations and persecutory beliefs.

entries.summary: Progressed from acute assessment to community mental health care.
entries.service: HBTT, Early Intervention in Psychosis and CMHT
entries.reason: Treatment and support following diagnosis of schizophrenia.
entries.outcome: Transferred from A&E to Home-Based Treatment Team, then Early Intervention in Psychosis and subsequently CMHT, where he has been supported for six months.

entries.summary: Enhanced Care Programme Approach plan is active.
entries.need: Coordinated community treatment, recovery support and risk management.
interventions: Support worker contact every two weeks
Notify care coordinator of material changes in risk

entries.summary: Referred to CGL substance misuse services.
entries.outcome: Referral is open but Adam has not engaged with the service.

catalogue.synopsis: A young adult with recently diagnosed schizophrenia, limited social support and a history requiring trauma-informed and safeguarding-aware care.
